newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 0.38 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 0.38 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was up 0.31 points, or 0.38 percent at 82.81 on Tuesday after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index provisionally fell 43.82 points to 3,724.92. The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 16.53 percent from 13.70 percent on Monday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
